Fresh mobile/www receives exact index, fonts and branding. Each staged asset is byte-compared with the committed source before the commands.

One spawn per command with existing finite timeout; raw stdout/stderr plus bytes/SHA, exit/signal/error, argv/cwd and timing are stored. Nonzero or timed-out commands remain failures while later commands run once.

Fresh cosmetics output is copied into standalone/rift-cosmetics after its command. All normal results and caught preparation/identity failures proceed to a recursive original-byte manifest, excluding only the manifest itself.
